thig6.5:1.1: ucce kule ahaṃ jātā bahuvitte mahaddhane | vaṇṇarūpena sampannā dhītā Majjhassa atrajā. || ||
thig6.5:2.1: patthitā rājaputtehi seṭṭhiputtehi gijjhitā | pitu me pesayi dūtaṃ detha mayhaṃ Anopamaṃ. || ||
thig6.5:3.1: yattakaṃ tulitā esā tuyhaṃ dhītā Anopamā | tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca. || ||
thig6.5:4.1: sāhaṃ disvāna sambuddhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ | tassa pādāni vanditvā ekamantaṃ upāvisiṃ. || ||
thig6.5:5.1: so me dhammam adesesi anukampāya Gotamo | nisinnā āsane tasmiṃ phusayiṃ tatiyaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
thig6.5:6.1: tato kesāni chetvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ | sājja me sattamī ratti yato taṇhā visositā. || || Anopamā. ||
